{{Quote|Just what we need. Another politician in charge. Nothing to do with us.|Hydra's uncle|<ref name="Reckoning" />}}
The [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]], [[Hydra (Grand Inquisitor)|Hydra]], in her early life, was raised with a silent and savage '''uncle''' on her [[Hydra's homeworld|homeworld]] who she served and endured. Her uncle wasn't too pleased about [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] rise to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], spitting on the floor. However, Palpatine's rise excited Hydra and so one day she left her uncle to serve a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|better master]] than her uncle.<ref name="Reckoning" />
